items.rationale: Section 2.4.3 covers the internal frost fracture, and §§7.1.9–7.1.10 limit renewal to a like-for-like valve. Allow €55 gross for one standard valve.
Section 7.1.9 covers connection elements that need to be renewed with the fractured fitting. Allow €20 gross for one standard hose.
Section 7.1.9 covers necessary labour to repair the fractured fitting. Allow 3 hours at €90 gross per hour.
Sections 7.1.7(e) and 7.1.9 cover consumables actually used in the repair, not general shop overhead under §7.1.8. Allow €13 gross for ordinary repair consumables.
Sections 7.1.9 and 7.1.11 allow one attendance for the plumber who performed the covered repair. Allow €30 gross for that visit, without a duplicate attendance charge for leak detection.

Sections 2.4.5 and 5.2.2 expressly cover imaging equipment used to locate the fracture. Allow €65 gross for camera use, below the €2,500 event cap; the six plumbing lines together total €453, consistent with Case 7.

Sections 3.1.4 and 3.5(a) exclude the separate exterior frost damage; the invoice's reference to water does not establish damage from the internal leak. No facade amount is payable on the stated facts.
Section 3.5(b) excludes taking off plaster loosened by exterior frost. Section 5.2.1 does not cover removal or disposal from an unaffected part.
Section 3.5(b) excludes renewal of the substrate beneath the frost-damaged facade finish. No base-plaster amount is payable.
Section 3.5(b) excludes further work on the elevation carried out with the excluded facade repair. The line identifies no separate insured work that can be allocated under §9.6.
Section 3.5(b) excludes preparation and re-forming of the substrate beneath the failed exterior finish. None of this line is payable.
Section 3.5(b) excludes successive coats applied to the frost-damaged facade, regardless of coat count. None of the four coats is payable.
Section 3.5(b) excludes drying of the exterior substrate in this repair. Section 7.1.7(c) covers drying only where an insured event damaged the part being dried.
Section 3.5(b) expressly excludes priming as part of reinstating the failed exterior finish. No priming amount is payable.
Sections 3.5(c) and 7.1.11 exclude labour attributable to the uncovered facade work. None of the five painter hours is payable.
Section 3.5(c) excludes flat-rate charges attributable to the uncovered facade work. If this is an administrative charge, §7.1.8(b) also excludes it.
